was: Cattaraugus County marina park on the Allegheny Reservoir (Kinzua), just north of the Pennsylvania line.  About two-thirds of the sites are seasonal; the 23 transient sites are the ones that book online. --Claude

was: Campground with a canoe landing on the Pine River, a Blue Ribbon trout stream, inside the Manistee National Forest near Wellston: water/electric, electric-only and rustic sites, cabins, trailer and pop-up rentals, and fishing ponds.  A site's price covers a family of 2 adults and 2 children with one RV.  Not rated on RV Life; Campspot reviewers give it 4.8 (32 reviews). --Claude

was: Lot-ownership RV resort off Summerlin Rd near the Fort Myers Beach causeway that rents owners' sites by the night.  Travel trailers only May to October, and an RV that doesn't match its booking (type, length, age, condition) can be turned away at check-in without a refund. --Claude
